*PharmaCraft Daily - 14 Oct 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (Central Nervous System)
Q: Morphine mainly acts on which receptor?
Ans: Mu opioid
Why: Morphine is a mu opioid receptor agonist, giving analgesia, euphoria, respiratory depression and constipation.

🩺 *NEET PG* (Endocrine)
Q: GLP-1 receptor agonist among these?
Ans: Liraglutide
Why: Liraglutide and semaglutide are GLP-1 agonists; they aid weight loss and have cardiovascular benefit.

🏥 *INI-CET* (Anticancer)
Q: Immune checkpoint inhibitor pembrolizumab targets?
Ans: PD-1
Why: Pembrolizumab and nivolumab block PD-1, restoring T-cell antitumour activity. Ipilimumab targets CTLA-4.

🌍 *FMGE* (Endocrine)
Q: Which insulin has the fastest onset?
Ans: Lispro
Why: Rapid-acting analogues (lispro, aspart, glulisine) act within 15 minutes, given at mealtime. Glargine is long-acting basal.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Drug Development)
Q: An ANDA (Abbreviated New Drug Application) is used for?
Ans: Generic drugs
Why: An ANDA is filed for generic drugs, requiring bioequivalence to the reference product rather than new efficacy trials.
